sloka: अहं पौलस्त्यतनयो दशग्रीवश्च नामतः ।मुनेर्विश्रवसो यस्तु तृतीयो ब्रह्मणो ऽभवत् ।। ७.१२.१५ ॥
transliteration: ahaṁ paulastyatanayo daśagrīvaśca nāmataḥ ।munerviśravaso yastu tṛtīyo brahmaṇo 'bhavat ।। 7.12.15 ॥

translations.english: "I am the son of Pulastya, named Dashagriva, and I am the son of Sage Vishrava, who was the third (generation) from Brahma."
